name: Synn
message: 「It's nothing serious, though. When I woke up this morning, I was sleeping without my blanket on.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's rare. You usually don't toss and turn in your sleep.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, my bad. It was cold this morning, so I borrowed your blanket.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You little--! You're Synn's doll, and you've got the nerve to steal your own master's blanket?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「There was just a comfy-looking blanket sitting right there. I didn't know it belonged to Master Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... My name wasn't written on the blanket, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Azel! Are you saying you're fine with Synn catching a cold!?」

name: Azel
message: 「In the first place, what sort of illness is a cold?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A deadly disease that'll kill ya in the worst-case scenario!」

name: Azel
message: 「Though his actions were logical, disciplinary punishment is required.」

name: Azel
message: 「This level does not qualify as disciplinary punishment.」

name: Azel
message: 「You, take him to the hospital! If we hurry, we might still make it in time!」

name: Paqy
message: 「A-A sharp pain so intense I feel like I'm--gyaaa--awakening to a whole new world!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's the direction this is taking all of a sudden!?」

name: Azel
message: 「What are you stalling for? If you won't take him, I will」

name: Synn
message: 「What?! Am I suffering from a terminal illness where I might not even see tomorrow?!」
Nanaka's palm, chilled through by the winter air, felt pleasant against my forehead.

name: Paqy
message: 「My insides are coming out, coming out!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I was just checking Synn's temperature. It's not the worst-case scenario at all--just a super mild cold, so he's fine」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so... Then it is fine」

name: Synn
message: 「If I ended up hospitalized, I'd have to sell the apartment」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nobody would buy a property like that. The bank would just seize it as collateral for pennies on the dollar」

name: Synn
message: 「No way... I don't want a plot twist like 'Kirara'...」
All of a sudden, Azel's hand touched my forehead and was immediately pulled back.
Once again, Nanaka's hand touched my forehead.
Azel's hand tries to push away Nanaka's hand resting over my forehead.

name: Synn
message: 「Um... I'm fine, so let's all get along, okay?」
Looking at the photo displayed on the laptop monitor,

name: Misa
message: 「How awful! Who did this to Paqy-san!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa. He's all tattered. This is what they mean by wearing rags and having a diary at heart, isn't it」

name: Azel
message: 「He was already like this when I took it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This photo is hilarious! We definitely have to put it on display!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's harsh after you're the one who took it」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right. If we're using a photo of Paqy-san, this cute one is better」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel's the real deal, after all. *Cough, cough*」

name: Misa
message: 「Could that be a cold? No, surely not. There's no way you'd ever catch a cold--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even Sacchin catches colds, so that's just a superstition」

name: Misa
message: 「Even Takahashi-san catches them... That's oddly convincing」

name: Ria
message: 「The photos Azel-chan took have really piled up, haven't they?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't tell me you've already gotten the whole student body?」

name: Synn
message: 「Transfer complete. It's still only about three-quarters, if I remember right」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I told you before, I'm the one in charge of transferring the data」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? It won't open? 'Please enter the pass-word'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. You set it the other day, remember?」

name: Synn
message: 「They're the photos of the students Azel picked out for the Holy Night Festival」
The fact that she went out of her way to take the ones for the exhibition on a digital camera shows how conscientious she is.

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder what kind of photo mine is. I hope it turned out cute」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hisu's is the one where she shoved celery sticks up her nostrils」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, it can't be helped. I'll save it as something to look forward to at the Holy Night Festival, so I'll let you off the hook for today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That kinda sounds like a sore loser villain line」

name: Azel
message: 「...Looking forward to the Holy Night Festival--」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong... Huh, your face is totally pale」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm fine. It's nothing. I just got a little dizzy」

name: Synn
message: 「Want to go to the nurse's office?」
As if the color draining from his face a moment ago had been a lie, Azel's complexion looked no different than usual.
